description: This file defines a configuration class for Cobalt on Linux, including test filters and environment variables, and references external modules for configuration and testing.

classes.name: CobaltLinuxConfiguration
classes.description: A configuration class for Cobalt on Linux that extends cobalt_configuration.CobaltConfiguration, providing test filtering and environment variable setup.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CobaltLinuxConfiguration with platform configuration, application name, and directory, delegating to the superclass constructor.

methods.name: GetTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of test filters, extending the superclass filters with additional filtered tests.

methods.name: GetWebPlatformTestFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of web platform test filters, including a specific timing-sensitive test.

methods.name: GetTestEnvVariables
methods.description: Provides environment variables for different test suites, mainly configuring ASAN options.
